evals.prompt: set up SBOM generation and artifact signing for our release pipeline
evals.expected_output: Generates an SBOM as a build step (Syft, cdxgen, etc.) stored alongside the artifact indexed by build ID, signs every artifact with cosign/sigstore or an identity-based flow, and enforces signature (and provenance) verification as a fail-closed admission gate at deploy time.

evals.prompt: same commit keeps producing different dependency versions on rebuild
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses unpinned dependencies or floating tags/version ranges as the cause and fixes it by pinning exact versions with a lockfile and verifying package checksums/signatures, so a build run twice from the same commit is byte-identical.

evals.prompt: can we just use FROM node:latest and npm install to keep it simple
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: floating tags and unpinned installs let the same build command silently pull a different, potentially compromised artifact tomorrow; recommends a pinned, digest-referenced base image and npm ci against a committed lockfile instead.
